run_validate_translation: run the validate_translation script with --language flag to check missing translated sections
load_sections_function: load section names from a language toctree YAML file using load_sections
review_load_sections: review the load_sections function that parses _toctree.yml and returns a set of section names
test_validate_translation: test the validate_translation script by passing a language code to compare against English sections
refactor_load_sections: refactor load_sections to support additional toctree YAML fields or nested chapter structures
